input: Build a reading nook under the stairs

gold.taskTitle: Build a reading nook under the stairs
gold.taskDescription: Transform the space under a staircase into a functional and comfortable reading nook.

questions.title: Is the under-stair space currently empty or occupied?
questions.description: Understand the current state of the space to determine how much clearing or prep work is needed.

questions.title: What are the approximate dimensions of the space?
questions.description: Get the height, width, and depth measurements to plan the layout and built-ins accurately.

questions.title: Do you want built-in seating or freestanding furniture?
questions.description: Determine whether the nook will involve carpentry and permanent fixtures or movable pieces.

questions.title: What is your budget range for this project?
questions.description: Establish financial boundaries to guide material choices and whether professional help is needed.

questions.title: Will you do the work yourself or hire someone?
questions.description: Clarify whether this is a DIY project or requires sourcing and coordinating contractors.

questions.title: Do you want storage built into the nook as well?
questions.description: Determine if shelving, drawers, or cubbies should be incorporated into the design.

questions.title: Is there an existing light source or does one need adding?
questions.description: Assess whether electrical work or a lighting solution needs to be planned for the nook.
